KaTeX 0.19.0, MIT license. Files copied from the npm package `katex@0.19.0`:
`dist/katex.min.js`, `dist/contrib/auto-render.min.js`, and `LICENSE`.

The problem viewer uses native MathML output, so it does not need KaTeX's HTML
layout styles or web fonts. Both scripts are served locally, without a CDN.
Options and delimiters: https://katex.org/docs/autorender
